author: ship_page_visuals
scope: Complete independent reading of all 17 dated scopes, 68 labels and 68 explanations against the accepted Russian text.
checks: English technical terms distinguish armoured cruisers from protected cruisers, single from twin mounts, shields from turrets and shafts from propellers.
Fighting tops, forecastles, casemates and calibre receive the explanations supplied by the Russian text.
Photographic dates and uncertainties, stylized geometry and invisible internal protection remain explicit.

Late Russian corrections are retained: no selected boiler count for Diana or Pallada, no stronger-gun assertion for Pobeda, Diana's report is retrospective, and Petropavlovsk's underwater hull is not described as separately protected.
Machine comparison confirms unchanged 68 IDs, coordinates, weapon links, source IDs and photograph URLs.
resolvedFindings: Author independently revised generic mast labels to Masts and platforms before this complete reading; the reviewed version does not imply fighting tops on all slender masts.
